description.value:
Price priceless; Slot none; Weight —

A data spike holding the entertainment deck's records, partial crew logs and Celmak's footage of every contestant. Its owner gains a +4 bonus on Knowledge checks about the Divinity, Silver Mount and Androffans. It also holds one secret of your choice, such as a maintenance route into Silver Mount, crew lists, or logs from before Unity went mad.

Found in: The 113th Take (Casandalee's episode).
